primary_measure: failed gram inserts per level, from the probe's own counter (loader token_drain line, insert_fail_cumulative): the first level with failed inserts is the capacity point

limits: a synthetic worst case (every call a new gram); real workloads repeat grams, so the map holds more calls per window than here; one node
